title: Core finite coefficient construction for a descended compact neighborhood
statement: For a field k, a k-scheme X, a commutative k-algebra A, an open V in X_A, and x ∈ V, there are a finitely generated subalgebra B and compact open W in X_B whose canonical projection preimage contains x and is contained in V.

proof.text: Let I be the finitely generated k-subalgebras of A, ordered by inclusion. Bottom makes I nonempty and the supremum of two finitely generated subalgebras gives directedness. The already proved CommRingCat.isColimitFGSubalgebraCocone exhibits A as their filtered colimit. Applying the right adjoint Spec gives a limit cone c with point Spec A. Form the diagram E of pullbacks X_B and the cone e with point X_A and legs canonicalProjection. Verify its naturality on the two pullback projections using c.w. The pullback squares isPullback_baseChangeMap and the connected-limit theorem isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected show e is limiting. Every transition is affine because it is a base change of a map between affine spectra. All diagram data and commuting equations are constructed directly in the Lean proof.

Choose an affine open U in X_A containing x and contained in V by exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. It is compact. Apply Mathlib exists_preimage_eq (the compact-open descent clause of pqf-lem-limit-qc-open-descends, whose Mathlib form only needs a cofiltered index and affine transitions) to E, e, and U. Obtain a stage B and compact open W with canonicalProjection inverse image equal to U. Rewrite this equality to obtain point membership and containment in V. No compactness or quasi-separatedness of X or of the stages is assumed.

proof_origin.place: exists_preimage_eq (Stacks 01Z4(1)); isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected; isColimitFGSubalgebraCocone. Direct inverse-limit proof written by N3 replacing the coefficient plan of Stacks 0388.

mathlib_searches.query: pointwise principal open neighborhoods of base changed scheme defined over finitely generated subalgebras
Every point in an open of X base changed to A has a neighborhood descending to a compact open over a finitely generated subalgebra

lean.statement: theorem exists_descended_qc_neighborhood_core (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (V : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Opens) (x : ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))) (hx : x ∈ V) : ∃ (B : Subalgebra k A), B.FG ∧ ∃ (W : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)))).Opens), IsCompact W.1 ∧ x ∈ (canonicalProjection k X f A B) ⁻¹ᵁ W ∧ (canonicalProjection k X f A B) ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ V
